method.fluxDefinition: Positive change in log1p(100*Hann FFT magnitude / NFFT), averaged over40Hz-12kHz; candidate local maxima exceed both80th percentile and median+3MAD
method.timestampClaimMethod: Uses unpruned prominent peaks within30ms;80ms pruning only affects reported event list/plot
method.tempoCriteria: A117-123BPM local autocorrelation peak >=.20, >=85% strongest tested lag, >=8 high transients, and >=60% high transients within60ms of an optimized0.5s grid; measures periodicity only.

cutProximity.visualDescription: Hard palette/material change to orange/black while retaining the title and spherical subject. Horizontal glitch breakup and a pitch reversal carry the title toward the upper curved surface; by frame70 / 2.336s the lens reads as a broad open hemisphere, with a reflected lower half. This is a materially distinct framing state, not a stationary sphere with a changed background.
Hard cut to a single chrome rounded-rectangle ring on light gray, centered in a fixed frontal composition.
Same ring geometry/framing, transparent clear-glass treatment. This change was missed by the 0.08 scene-score threshold and was found by reading every frame.
Same ring, reflective gold.
Same ring, pale turquoise translucent/matte treatment.
Same ring, dark woven/carbon-like tiled surface.
Chrome/clear ring returns with a different reflection treatment. A repeated material on the same subject is deliberate.
Same centered ring silhouette rendered as coarse purple/magenta square voxels.
Ring against full-frame defocused green/blue/red light instead of gray. Interior becomes translucent colored glass.
Hard cut to full-frame deep red/magenta, a central rose-like point/ripple rosette and softly glowing forms at right. No marketing type.

Hard cut to yellow/orange-edged concentric polygon bands on magenta; a dark perforated curved strip whips across the foreground. Changes within this interval are fast motion rather than every scene-score candidate being a cut.
Hard cut to a warm yellow field containing a six-blade/aperture-like dotted emblem. Its pattern deforms and drifts.
Hard cut back to dense pale/cyan/purple character/dot surface on black. This visibly revisits the opener's material family; it is not a new product claim.
Hard cut to a twisting point/line shell, orange/pink at left/top and violet at right, with deep black openings. It rotates/deforms, filling most of the frame.
Hard cut to a central cluster of iridescent, folded/cube-like lobes on nearly black indigo. Much larger negative margins than the preceding macro.
Hard cut to a pale silver/black folded pinwheel surface, tightly cropped, with alternating pale/black rectangular background areas.
Full-frame lime chevrons with dense diagonal grain/lines.
Purple/cream stepped geometric stripe treatment.
Cyan/yellow zigzag treatment.
Magenta/yellow stepped stripe treatment. The four rapid changes are ~0.10-0.13s each, not multi-second hero scenes.
Hard cut to acid-green folded/glyph-like material macro.
Hard cut to orange extruded, smoothly rounded letter/glyph-like macro.
Hard cut to cream/blue translucent folded/glyph-like macro. These four clips repeat a large cropped-material framing idea with ~0.4s cadence.

Hard cut to tilted editor interface showing a desktop landing-page preview. Readable hero: `Plan, build, and ship / from one place.` Monochrome rays dominate the preview; tool chrome remains visible. A white cursor approaches responsive controls.

Hard cut to a dark editor displaying layered cyan/yellow/purple/pink rectangular fields and repeated binary digits. Its canvas changes internally while the tool panel and selection guides remain visible.

cutProximityContext.interpretation: Descriptive proximity only. Many detected events cover a large part of the timeline, so proximity can occur by chance and does not establish intentional beat-sync.

hearing: NOT PERFORMED. The runtime cannot ingest audio. Metrics do not establish genre, SFX identity, speech or musical intent.
